title: Tunisian Beef Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew made with tender beef and aromatic spices. Traditionally cooked in a clay tagine pot, but suitable for any slow cooker.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Brown the beef cubes on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the beef to a slow cooker.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the ground cumin, coriander, salt, and pepper.
Add the chopped kidney and cook for 2 minutes.
Stir in the chopped juicy and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the browned beef and any accumulated juices to the slow cooker.
Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or high for 1-2 hours.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
